name: ChainMail
source:
Don't stop reading! What if sometimes the mail we dismiss as junk was telling the truth?

ChainMail is a short visual novel about forwarding on chain letters without considering the consequences. The story is primarily told via email conversations held by Robert 'Bob' Forrest and his friend Dave Hudson.

[From [url=https://marionette.itch.io/chainmail]Itch.io[/url]]
